TestBackupRestore::test_no_data_resurrec.description: Single node: insert 10 rows, flush, ALTER DROP c2 + ADD c2, insert 10 more rows, flush. Stop node, copy sstables, save 'DESC KEYSPACE ks WITH INTERNALS'; drop ks, rmtree data, recreate schema from the description, assert re-described schema equals the original, copy sstables back offline and restart. Assert old rows have c2=null (no resurrection) and new rows keep c2 (no loss). Guards the documented backup procedure (DESC SCHEMA WITH INTERNALS emitting 'ALTER TABLE ... DROP c2 USING TIMESTAMP'), scylladb PR 18115.
